name: MindIOU
description:
MindIOU is the Even G2 learning surface for Spiral, a local-first cognitive compiler. Instead of asking users to manually choose courses or maintain a large flashcard library, Spiral detects reusable learning increments from real work and turns them into short, source-linked active-recall cards.

The first release focuses on a complete AI-assisted work learning loop. A local collector accepts structured AI-assisted work events only from projects the user has explicitly allowlisted. Before anything is sent to the learning service, the collector removes common API keys, access tokens, passwords, environment-variable values, and private keys. Routine file reads, repeated commands, and low-value logs are not intended to become learning material.

After an AI-assisted work session, the cognitive compiler does not summarize the whole conversation. It asks what the user originally wanted to do, where a knowledge gap appeared, what reusable principle was learned, how that principle maps to the user's own project, and what question would prove genuine understanding. A turn may produce zero, one, two, or three knowledge atoms. When no meaningful learning increment exists, no card is created.

Each knowledge atom contains one concept, a plain-language explanation, the user's project context, an example, a common mistake, an active-recall question, a concise answer, confidence, and references to its source events. Similar concepts from the same project are deduplicated so the system strengthens an existing atom instead of creating an endless pile of repeated notes.

On Even G2, MindIOU shows one large, glanceable question at a time. The display intentionally contains very little information: the recall prompt, a short supporting line, progress, and stable navigation guidance. The core concept is rendered as a bitmap so it remains substantially larger than the fixed SDK text size. The interaction path has been designed around the gesture behavior verified on real hardware: swipe up for the previous card and swipe down for the next card, with rapid input coalescing so the final visible card follows the user's latest action.

The phone view acts as a compact control console. Today shows the due queue and the current question. Capture can compile a pasted AI-assisted work record or import direct study material. Knowledge exposes the resulting atoms, project context, source count, and confidence so incorrect extraction can be noticed. Review summarizes recent retrieval activity. Settings keeps the learning API and optional voice controls separate from study content.

Review feedback updates the scheduler rather than merely changing the screen. A card can be marked understood, partially understood, not understood, or skipped. Understood cards move farther into the future; partial and incorrect answers return sooner. The first scheduler uses transparent fixed weights for due state, recent project relevance, mastery gap, and repeated occurrence. This keeps the behavior inspectable while the product is still learning what signals are useful.

MindIOU also retains AI tutoring and voice interaction. Learners can explain a concept in their own words, receive concise feedback, hear what was correct, identify a missing point, and answer one short follow-up question. Speech transcription runs through the configured backend, while simple local fallback behavior keeps basic card review usable when AI is unavailable.

Privacy is part of the architecture, not a settings afterthought. Secrets stay in the local backend environment file and are never packaged into the EHPK. Raw AI-assisted work text can be discarded after extraction. Every generated card keeps source IDs without exposing the full source on the glasses. The durable store survives WebView restarts so Android suspension does not erase the learning queue.

This release deliberately does not claim reliable all-day background listening. The public plugin environment can capture microphone audio while the app is active, but background WebView lifetime varies by platform. Future Spiral releases can add short voice thought capture and evolving thought topics without making ambient recording a prerequisite for the core AI-assisted work-to-learning loop.

The product principle is simple: daily AI assistance should leave the user with stronger transferable understanding, not only a completed task. MindIOU uses Even G2 to place the smallest useful retrieval question into the moments where a phone or course would be too heavy.
